chunks: And from him, from al-Naḍr, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, from al-Fuḍayl, who said:
I asked him about forgetfulness, so he said: “In salat al-maghrib, if you are not certain about what is between three and four, then repeat your salat.”

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent doubt occurring in prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib prayer, which consists of three rak'ahs
key_terms.لَمْ تَحْفَظْ: you did not retain certainty or proper awareness

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts between three and four rak'ahs in salat al-maghrib?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt arising in salat al-maghrib. It states that if a person cannot preserve certainty between three and four rak'ahs in the maghrib prayer, the prayer must be repeated.
